name: vianido
description: Search and research US nonprofits on Vianido from a conversation, and keep the profiles, metrics, About pages and updates of organizations you manage up to date.

interface.longDescription: Find nonprofits by name, cause or place, read and compare their Vianido profiles, and cite them, without leaving the conversation. If you manage an organization on Vianido, keep its profile, social links, logo, UN SDGs and metrics up to date, draft and publish its About page, and post its updates.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find nonprofits working on food access in my city on Vianido and compare what they do.
